prompt:
Use aged paper, restrained sepia color, halftone print texture, and archival cutout framing.
Treat photographs and documents as tactile evidence layers with legible hierarchy.
Avoid: Glossy modern gradients, neon color, and playful preschool proportions.
Composition: Organize evidence in measured overlapping planes with one dominant archival focal point.
Composition: Preserve readable margins, captions, and document edges instead of filling every gap.
Create ONE COMPLETE 2x2 square registered animation sheet on genuine transparent alpha. Use the attached object as the immutable design reference. Top-left: SEALED, triangular flap folded shut. Top-right: UNFOLDING, triangular flap lifted halfway with only the upper edge of the blank letter visible. Bottom-left: OPEN, the flap fully lifted and the same blank ivory letter extending upward. Preserve exact envelope width, bottom and center in all three states. Bottom-right EMPTY transparent unused cell. Each quadrant has identical canvas coordinates. Object center x=50%, baseline y=88% of each cell. Keep 12% clear margins; no piece may cross a quadrant. No cell borders, labels or numbers. A single antique ivory rectangular paper envelope with warm sepia grain, subtle deckled edges and a faint indigo inner lining. No string or wax seal. Front view of its back flap, parallel to canvas; elegant tactile paper craft. Completely blank with no handwriting. No text, logos, watermark, backdrop or baked checkerboard. Full object including stem or envelope edges visible; refined printed paper details.
